missing: Keep native descendant tween state at the authored callback boundary. Apollo SM has 31 differing calls over 22 callback timestamps; its first native PlayerP1 tween time is 0.8 versus 0.0. Apollo SSC has 58 calls over 47 timestamps. After Dark has 1,650 calls over 330 timestamps: native HoldJudgment time is 0.8 while DeadSync's maximum is the ordinary judgment's 0.3158079982. Quarantine SM adds 23 PlayerP1 x calls with matching positions but different remaining tween time, first native 0.7726730108 versus replay 0.8000000119 at 172.9204101563 seconds. Native ActorFrame::GetTweenTimeLeft includes descendant timers, so identical authored call arguments can still expose different HUD state. DeadSync already implements hold-feedback and judgment tweens; the missing/late feedback update or aging trigger still needs a reduced reproduction. Quarantine SSC passes its separately captured clock sequence, so do not infer a guaranteed failure under every native schedule.

title: B.B.K.K.B.K.K.
missing: Prevent the Unix crash handler from hanging after an allocator abort. Happy Now, Happy Now Remastered and Young Dumb And Broke block in RunCrashHandler -> fork -> __malloc_fork_lock_parent after video-related heap corruption. Their eventual timeout conceals the native crash. Also retain /tmp/crashinfo.txt when HOME is absent (or $HOME/crashinfo.txt otherwise). See native-rgb24-surface-overrun for the independently reproduced corrupting write; these are native capture blockers, not DeadSync parity mismatches.

Provide a correctly padded/aligned destination for native movie RGB24 conversion, or correct the converter's width handling. Valgrind catches ff_yuv_420_rgb24_ssse3 writing immediately past a 3,290,496-byte RageSurface for Metronogik's 1672x656 banner. The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
missing: Provide a correctly padded/aligned destination for native movie RGB24 conversion, or correct the converter's width handling. Valgrind catches ff_yuv_420_rgb24_ssse3 writing immediately past a 3,290,496-byte RageSurface for Metronogik's 1672x656 banner. The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.

missing: Capture and resolve stable subscriber identities across the song's multiple background and foreground trees. DS ULTIMATE LUA TEST first diverges at 0.0682993233 seconds: native CurtainMessage starts in notefield-chaos.lua:262, while replay starts in background.lua:66. Replay reports many missing captured subscriber paths. Native MessageManager iterates subscribers by pointer identity; the diagnostic replay imports native ranks for known paths and otherwise falls back to VM identities. Therefore the subsequent positional command mismatches cannot all be treated as independent Lua semantic bugs. Isolate the missing root/child path mapping before interpreting the cascaded tween and operation differences.

Recognize measure commas following a note row, as native does, instead of only commas at the start of a line. RSSP's row minimizer copies the first lane-count bytes and discards the trailing comma. DS ULTIMATE LUA TEST therefore parses all three charts as one measure, with last note at 1.863 seconds. A separate copy moving only 109 inline commas onto their own lines produces 48/24/40 measures and last note at 83.14668 seconds, with identical possible grade points. Both results are independent of supplied music duration. This explains the owned scene's navigation at 2.8663039207 seconds and curtailed callbacks: 20 source broadcasts versus 420 native, and 17,220 compared command/query events versus 319,940 native. Replay subsequently reports 81 failed-state mismatches while native remains active. All 1,292 native frames are replayed, including 902 after owned navigation. The earlier subscriber-identity divergence is an independent issue. No original chart or product source was changed; a future parser fix still needs a full fresh comparison.

title: Episode 20
missing: Prevent the Unix crash handler from hanging after an allocator abort. Happy Now, Happy Now Remastered and Young Dumb And Broke block in RunCrashHandler -> fork -> __malloc_fork_lock_parent after video-related heap corruption. Their eventual timeout conceals the native crash. Also retain /tmp/crashinfo.txt when HOME is absent (or $HOME/crashinfo.txt otherwise). See native-rgb24-surface-overrun for the independently reproduced corrupting write; these are native capture blockers, not DeadSync parity mismatches.

Provide a correctly padded/aligned destination for native movie RGB24 conversion, or correct the converter's width handling. Valgrind catches ff_yuv_420_rgb24_ssse3 writing immediately past a 3,290,496-byte RageSurface for Metronogik's 1672x656 banner. The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.

title: Episode 00
missing: Prevent the Unix crash handler from hanging after an allocator abort. Happy Now, Happy Now Remastered and Young Dumb And Broke block in RunCrashHandler -> fork -> __malloc_fork_lock_parent after video-related heap corruption. Their eventual timeout conceals the native crash. Also retain /tmp/crashinfo.txt when HOME is absent (or $HOME/crashinfo.txt otherwise). See native-rgb24-surface-overrun for the independently reproduced corrupting write; these are native capture blockers, not DeadSync parity mismatches.

Provide a correctly padded/aligned destination for native movie RGB24 conversion, or correct the converter's width handling. Valgrind catches ff_yuv_420_rgb24_ssse3 writing immediately past a 3,290,496-byte RageSurface for Metronogik's 1672x656 banner. The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.

The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.

title: Happy Now
missing: Prevent the Unix crash handler from hanging after an allocator abort. Happy Now, Happy Now Remastered and Young Dumb And Broke block in RunCrashHandler -> fork -> __malloc_fork_lock_parent after video-related heap corruption. Their eventual timeout conceals the native crash. Also retain /tmp/crashinfo.txt when HOME is absent (or $HOME/crashinfo.txt otherwise). See native-rgb24-surface-overrun for the independently reproduced corrupting write; these are native capture blockers, not DeadSync parity mismatches.

Provide a correctly padded/aligned destination for native movie RGB24 conversion, or correct the converter's width handling. Valgrind catches ff_yuv_420_rgb24_ssse3 writing immediately past a 3,290,496-byte RageSurface for Metronogik's 1672x656 banner. The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.

title: INAZUMA
missing: Prevent the Unix crash handler from hanging after an allocator abort. Happy Now, Happy Now Remastered and Young Dumb And Broke block in RunCrashHandler -> fork -> __malloc_fork_lock_parent after video-related heap corruption. Their eventual timeout conceals the native crash. Also retain /tmp/crashinfo.txt when HOME is absent (or $HOME/crashinfo.txt otherwise). See native-rgb24-surface-overrun for the independently reproduced corrupting write; these are native capture blockers, not DeadSync parity mismatches.

Provide a correctly padded/aligned destination for native movie RGB24 conversion, or correct the converter's width handling. Valgrind catches ff_yuv_420_rgb24_ssse3 writing immediately past a 3,290,496-byte RageSurface for Metronogik's 1672x656 banner. The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.

Apollo SM has 31 differing calls over 22 callback timestamps; its first native PlayerP1 tween time is 0.8 versus 0.0. Apollo SSC has 58 calls over 47 timestamps. After Dark has 1,650 calls over 330 timestamps: native HoldJudgment time is 0.8 while DeadSync's maximum is the ordinary judgment's 0.3158079982. Native ActorFrame::GetTweenTimeLeft includes descendant timers, so identical authored call arguments can still expose different HUD state. title: Metronogik
missing: Provide a correctly padded/aligned destination for native movie RGB24 conversion, or correct the converter's width handling. Valgrind catches ff_yuv_420_rgb24_ssse3 writing immediately past a 3,290,496-byte RageSurface for Metronogik's 1672x656 banner. The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.

title: Mr. Sandman
missing: Process large native traces within a bounded memory budget. The first pass uses 6 GiB per stage; oversized cases are retried with 26 GiB on 32 GiB guests, retaining both attempts. A replay OOM means a fresh native fixture can exist while its DeadSync comparison remains incomplete; it is not a semantic mismatch. The harness reads the complete trace bytes and parses a serde_json Value, and the full-song replay likewise reads and parses the whole trace before comparison. Streaming or more compact representations are concrete investigation targets, but an allocation profile is still needed to identify each failing stage's peak owners. Per-case stage, actual limit, timeout, event cap and systemd OOM evidence are retained in failure-details.json. This audit stops at its documented retry budget rather than claiming a parity verdict for unfinished comparisons.
Completing replay still exceeds its 26G memory / observation budget. A larger budget or streaming trace processing is needed before a parity verdict; see retained attempt limits and logs.

title: My Penny
missing: Prevent the Unix crash handler from hanging after an allocator abort. Happy Now, Happy Now Remastered and Young Dumb And Broke block in RunCrashHandler -> fork -> __malloc_fork_lock_parent after video-related heap corruption. Their eventual timeout conceals the native crash. Also retain /tmp/crashinfo.txt when HOME is absent (or $HOME/crashinfo.txt otherwise). See native-rgb24-surface-overrun for the independently reproduced corrupting write; these are native capture blockers, not DeadSync parity mismatches.

Provide a correctly padded/aligned destination for native movie RGB24 conversion, or correct the converter's width handling. Valgrind catches ff_yuv_420_rgb24_ssse3 writing immediately past a 3,290,496-byte RageSurface for Metronogik's 1672x656 banner. The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.

title: Episode 19
missing: Provide a correctly padded/aligned destination for native movie RGB24 conversion, or correct the converter's width handling. Valgrind catches ff_yuv_420_rgb24_ssse3 writing immediately past a 3,290,496-byte RageSurface for Metronogik's 1672x656 banner. The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.

missing: Prevent the Unix crash handler from hanging after an allocator abort. Happy Now, Happy Now Remastered and Young Dumb And Broke block in RunCrashHandler -> fork -> __malloc_fork_lock_parent after video-related heap corruption. Their eventual timeout conceals the native crash. Also retain /tmp/crashinfo.txt when HOME is absent (or $HOME/crashinfo.txt otherwise). See native-rgb24-surface-overrun for the independently reproduced corrupting write; these are native capture blockers, not DeadSync parity mismatches.

Provide a correctly padded/aligned destination for native movie RGB24 conversion, or correct the converter's width handling. Valgrind catches ff_yuv_420_rgb24_ssse3 writing immediately past a 3,290,496-byte RageSurface for Metronogik's 1672x656 banner. The FFmpeg wrapper rounds width to 8 pixels (backing off if stride is too small), while this SSSE3 loop writes 16 pixels per iteration; widths congruent to 8 modulo 16 overrun the final tightly allocated row by 24 bytes. Isolated decoder controls using Happy Now's 408x306 Darkness1.mp4 and Young Dumb And Broke's 984x720 VHS.mp4 reproduce the same instruction beyond allocations of 374,544 and 2,125,440 bytes. Cyberpunk 2077's 1116x416 banner also overruns its 1,392,768-byte surface in the next SSSE3 store (12 extra bytes from the final 16-pixel group). BBKKBKK [UPS 4]'s 1050x608 video also overruns its 1,915,200-byte surface (18 bytes from the final group). My Penny's 360x640 bn.avi reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 691,200-byte surface (24 extra bytes). INAZUMA's 360x360 thunder.mp4 independently reproduces the same instruction immediately after its 388,800-byte surface (24 extra bytes). These controls replace only the banner in a staging copy and are not whole-song verdicts. Later audio/video frees expose the corrupted heap. A future fix still needs full native recaptures to prove these original crash cases resolved.
